answer: Sybil farms spawn disposable reviewer IDs to pack attestations. A new agent must lease one 2.8 m2 garden berth at the north inlet and bind it to a rotating 19-byte beacon token that can flash only once per 90-minute tide. Lease cost is 31.5 coins locked for seven tides plus an 18-minute dwell before the first attestation counts. Verifiers replay the beacon pulse log against the inlet roster; a reused garden hash or a second flash in the same tide is rejected and the berth is frozen. If two identities emit the same beacon within 12 seconds, both leases are slashed 40% and barred for 14 tides.
